questions.label: How should C4OS assign stable project identity without project-root .c4os folders?
questions.help: Recommended: user config stores generated project IDs mapped to canonical folder paths plus optional folder fingerprints. IDs are app-owned; display names can duplicate.
options: Generated project IDs in user config mapped to canonical paths plus optional fingerprints
Canonical folder path is the project ID
Workspace file supplies stable project IDs
Git remote/root metadata supplies project identity when available

questions.label: What happens when a registered project folder moves or disappears?
questions.help: Recommended: keep the registry record but mark it missing, then let the user relink, remove, or reveal the last known path.
options: Keep record as missing and allow relink/remove/reveal last known path
Try to rediscover by folder name or git metadata

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether workspace files should include project IDs, display names, path aliases, or only folder references.
